### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:M31 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-M31`.

**Outcome:** New room command owner handles room.create/invite/remove/ask_agents/turns/project/messages/reset, discussion.follow/room.discussion.follow, reactions and thread modifications through Store transactions.

**Owner:** Backend / Session Store. **Batch:** P2: business modules and deep Harness parity. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No new social-room UI or agent-selection algorithm; reuse existing room rules.
- No EngineService/Bridge/WorkSwarm daemon wrapper or shared old session database.
- Room/discussion/member metadata is a Gateway/application projection; Message/Session/Run records and history come only from public Store/AS operations. No room-owned second transcript or terminal writer.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve New room command owner handles room.create/invite/remove/ask_agents/turns/project/messages/reset, discussion.follow/room.discussion.follow, reactions and thread modifications through Store transactions, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py::EngineService._handle_request` into `server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py::RoomCommands; server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py::RoomRecords`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py::RoomCommands; server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py::RoomRecords

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py) — `EngineService._handle_request`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_discussions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_discussions.py) — `follow_discussion`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_conversations.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_conversations.py) — `register.modify`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_reactions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_reactions.py) — `react_as_person, react_as_agent`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Membership and write-authority checks
- Pagination cursor, discussion-root provenance
- Refuse deletion until active task stop confirmed
- Archive/pin/rename/read state

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Room mutations in compatibility transport
- Private EngineStore hooks as cross-component calls

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py
- server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py
- tests/server/agent_service/st/test_room_commands.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-M15](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/785)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M34](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/805), [DM31-M47](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/837)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-M06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/775), [DM31-M07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/776), [DM31-M26](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/778), [DM31-M08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/779)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Session Store revisioned room/message contract

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Create room, invite agent, set follows, paginate older messages, pin/rename/archive/unarchive thread and reset; snapshots preserve declared revisions.

**Failure:** Remove a busy agent or delete active thread is rejected; foreign discussion root or cursor cannot read another room.

**Concurrency:** Concurrent follow/unfollow and room reset use expected revision; one write wins and the other returns conflict without lost membership.


**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Existing:** - **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_engine_room_membership.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.

- **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_room_reactions.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.

- **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_engine_conversations.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.


**Planned:** **Command:** python -m unittest -v tests.server.agent_service.st.test_room_commands

**Participants:** Real new owner and public proxy, real extracted validation/state-transition leaves; temporary Store and controlled external dependencies.


**Status:** Not run; new suite is planned.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** room.create, room.messages, discussion.follow, room.discussion.follow, thread.modify, room membership. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0001, ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, AR06, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:M35 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-M35`.

**Outcome:** Reuse Core graph/claim/review algorithms while replacing TeamDatabase/plan-file authority with run-bound opaque host context state.

**Owner:** Opt-in team Harness. **Batch:** P2: business modules and deep Harness parity. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No distributed PostgreSQL/remote CLI rollout or reimplementation of scheduling algorithms; no default team enablement.
- No EngineService/Bridge/WorkSwarm daemon wrapper or shared old session database.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Reuse Core graph/claim/review algorithms while replacing TeamDatabase/plan-file authority with run-bound opaque host context state, adapt `harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/tools/task_manager.py::TeamTaskManager.add_graph, assign, claim, complete, verify_task` into `server/agent_service/harness/team/tasks.py::TeamTaskGraph; server/agent_service/harness/team/state.py::TeamCheckpoint`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/harness/team/tasks.py::TeamTaskGraph; server/agent_service/harness/team/state.py::TeamCheckpoint

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/tools/task_manager.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/tools/task_manager.py) — `TeamTaskManager.add_graph, assign, claim, complete, verify_task`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/tools/database/task_dao.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/tools/database/task_dao.py) — `task persistence operations`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/agent/team_agent.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/agent_teams/agent/team_agent.py) — `TeamAgent.coordination, task_manager`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Dependency ordering
- Single task claim
- Review/verification completion gates
- Leader/member identity and plan revision

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Independent TeamDatabase connection
- Plan writes outside execution provider
- Task graph deciding product terminal

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/harness/team/tasks.py
- server/agent_service/harness/team/state.py
- tests/server/agent_service/harness/st/test_team_graph.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-M08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/779)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M36](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/807)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-M09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/780), [DM31-M13](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/781), [DM31-M10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/782), [DM31-M12](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/783)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Opaque Harness checkpoint CAS contract

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Leader creates two prerequisite tasks and one dependent task; members claim prerequisites, submit/review results, dependent becomes runnable only after accepted completion.

**Failure:** Cycle/unknown member/failed review cannot unlock dependent; host snapshot failure leaves prior graph revision authoritative.

**Concurrency:** Two members claim same task concurrently: one succeeds; stale checkpoint after team generation change cannot replace current graph.


**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Existing:** - **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_workswarm_adapter.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.


**Planned:** **Command:** python -m unittest -v tests.server.agent_service.harness.st.test_team_graph

**Participants:** Real extracted Core team components and new scoped Harness/HostAPI; scripted model/provider, deterministic temporary host store.


**Status:** Not run; new suite is planned.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** team planning, team task graph, assignment, review, team checkpoint. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0001, ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, AR06, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md::Registration and consecutive stability` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/coverage.json; tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/combinations.json (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**

- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/stability.mjs](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/stability.mjs) — `stability gate`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

- Historical reports counted as latest-main passes

**Writable boundary:**

- tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/combinations.json

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-Q06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/823), [DM31-Q07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/824), [DM31-Q08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/825), [DM31-Q09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/826), [DM31-G11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/747), [DM31-M25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821), [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820)

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Account for all 36 frozen cases plus migration-specific cases
- Run any remaining cases through existing QA work owners with dedicated resources before closure
- E4/E5/E6 original consecutive stability gates remain intact
- Rerun affected pairs when main/integration head changes
- Baseline failures versus new regressions separately owned; no silent exemption
- Run source-mapped API/configuration contract fixtures for all registered action families, including M31–M47 and opt-in team. Dormant/rejected/testing-only actions retain their evidenced disposition; every action row points to a migration issue and explicit acceptance result.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Checks:** - Existing catalog/provenance/stability validators
- Integrated combinations selected in G11 with fresh exact-head evidence

**Commands (existing exact-case pair flow):**

```sh
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --plan /absolute/path/pair.json
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --execute /absolute/path/pair.json --side A
# Verify A recovery/release and the separately leased B route before B.
node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs --execute /absolute/path/pair.json --side B
```

The [existing pair procedure](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/docs/procedures/migration-ab.md) selects one exact current `caseFile` per operator-owned private pair plan; there is no `--group complete-corpus` selector. These plans are execution inputs under Q04's existing resource/recovery contract, not additional committed Q10 source files or permission to modify the wrapper. Q04's operator and Q10's independent QA coordinator must record the selected current-main A and latest integrated B heads, re-freeze/check the actual manifest and paired HAP/driver/assertion/calibration/build/backend identities, and obtain the actual grants before execution. Historical source pins above remain provenance, not substitutes for the selected pair freeze. Q10 still reconciles all 36 current workflows, disabled/supplemental cases, migration-specific cases, registered API/configuration families and integrated combinations through their existing owners. Original lane and applicable E4/E5/E6 same-version/same-build/same-condition two-consecutive-complete-pass requirements remain intact; pending tooling work or a focused smoke does not supply a full-group PASS.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. **Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** remaining-corpus-execution-evidence, release-dedicated-resources, current-integrated-head. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR08, AR09, AR10.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

[E6 source record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/76728bca7e00cd571589e4b8c3111d7c5a5003c2/tests/e2e/results/e6-565-20261106/README.md) records one local API26 debug10007→10008 upgrade and one debug10008 consent/sign-in case as local passes. Keep **REMINDER-01 local E2E PASS versus deployment/system-alarm BLOCKED** (deployed scheduler HTTP401, alarm declined/inventory unavailable). Retain **earlier deployed FILE-02 FAIL** (FIRST retained/separate final copy) separately from the isolated scripted-model writer/delivery-reader local PASS. FILEDELETE's local linked gateway-recovery passes do not clear its earlier whole-device-network BLOCKED trial where the endpoint remained reachable. Other local delivery/export/room-guard results retain their exact fixture/build/source scope. **Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Registry/Store exact ownership interfaces

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Create/test/pause a configured trigger, import a valid procedure and fire one matched event through public admission.

**Failure:** Invalid procedure link, unsupported provider or revoked source rejects; test mode does not produce an external effect.

**Concurrency:** Two matching event deliveries share durable firing identity; schedule worker and manual trigger cannot both execute the same firing.

**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.plugin_gateway.st.test_m46_boundary

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. - [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

839.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象：** 在对话里**直接粘贴图片**（不是发附件链接、也不是给文件路径）后，助手气泡只回一句英文 `The source is private to a different audience`，图片没有被解析成任何可读内容，也无法基于图片内容作答。

**复现步骤：**
1. 打开 DigitalMate 对话（web 渠道）。
2. 直接在输入框粘贴一张图片（例如 image_1794018912951.png），不附带文件路径。
3. 发送后观察助手回复。

**预期：** 同一会话内粘贴的图片应可被读取并用于回答；若暂不支持识图，应给出**中文、可理解**的能力提示（如「当前对话暂不支持直接识图，请改用文件方式」），而不是抛出内部 `PermissionError` 原文。

**实际：** 图片内容完全不可读，只回显 `The source is private to a different audience`。该报错容易被误解为用户贴错/图损坏，实际是本端把贴进来的图当作「当前会话无权访问的私有来源」挡在门外。

```text
The source is private to a different audience
```

**判断（可能根因，与历史单一致）：** 与 #453 同源——上传/落地成 Source 时 `allowed_actor_ids` 只写 `[principal_id]`，而 `source_visible_in_room` 要求 `people_in_room ⊆ allowed_actor_ids`；房间里有其他成员时校验失败，组 brief 时抛出该 `PermissionError` 并原文进气泡。修复 PR #462（把 room uploads 的 audience 设为 `room.member_ids`）目前仍为 open，未见合入/上线，故线上仍复现。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：DigitalMate 对话应用（digitalmate）
- 渠道：web
- 时间：2026-11-07 10:30–10:42（Asia/Shanghai），多轮贴图均可复现
- 输入方式：直接在对话中粘贴图片（非文件路径）
- 涉及图片示例：image_1794018912951.png
- 浏览器/系统：未单独记录，可后续补充

### Additional Information

- 关联历史单：#453（[Bug]: v0.1.6 发附件报 The source is private to a different audience）、修复 #462（fix(server): give room uploads the room audience (#453)，当前仍 open）。本单强调「直接粘贴图片」这条路径，且报错文案对用户有误导性。
- 建议：（1）附件/贴图路径保证同房间可读（合入 #462 思路）；（2）客户端把该错误映射为中文可理解提示，禁止内部 `PermissionError` 原文进气泡（关联 #359）；（3）短期若无法识图，贴图时直接给可操作引导。

### Version Information

- 仓库 main 分支对应版本；线上为当前部署构建（具体版本号待补）。历史同错见 v0.1.6（#453）。

### Screenshots / Recordings

- 该问题正是「贴图本身无法被读入」，故本端拿不到图片字节、无法自动附上截图；报错原文已在上方代码块给出。如需要可视证据，可请复现同学在客户端截图补充。

### 🚀 Background Description

目前 Node UT 已支持 Windows 和 Linux Runner，Linux 执行流程通过 GitHub API 下载源码快照。

为扩展香港 Runner 的使用范围，希望支持根据 Runner 环境配置选择源码下载方式，让香港机器通过 Git fetch 拉取源码，并复用预装的 Node、测试依赖和 Chromium，参与主仓 Node UT 门禁任务。

### Design Ideas

在 Linux Node UT 的源码下载步骤中读取环境变量 CODECHECK_SOURCE_MODE：

- 设置为 git 时，通过 Git fetch 拉取指定提交，并校验提交 SHA。
- 未配置时，继续使用现有 API 下载流程。
- 两种方式下载完成后，均创建测试所需的本地 Git 快照，进入相同的依赖检查、浏览器验证、测试和覆盖率流程。
- Windows Runner 继续使用现有执行流程。

香港 Runner 准备好依赖后，可通过添加 dm-nodeut 标签加入现有 Linux 任务池。

### Involved Public APIs

本次涉及 CI workflow 配置，不涉及产品公共 API。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

主要涉及 .github/workflows/ci.yml 中的 Linux Node UT 源码下载步骤。与 Runner 的 Git、Node.js、测试依赖及 Chromium 环境相关。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 执行 Bash 语法检查及现有 CI 配置测试，已通过。
- 在个人仓库选择测试分支，使用香港 Linux Runner 执行 Node UT。
- 验证 Git fetch 下载、预装依赖加载、Chromium 检查、单元测试及覆盖率步骤。
- 个人仓库 Node UT 已通过，总耗时约 4 分 20 秒。
- 合入后，为准备好的香港主仓 Runner 添加 dm-nodeut 标签，在主仓验证任务调度和完整执行结果。
851.title: [Feature]: 支持 Node UT 在香港 Runner 上通过 Git fetch 拉取源码

865.author: Jianyu010
865.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Parent #737, following the accepted F2 source-review finding in #745 and the [oversight response](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737#issuecomment-6704451391).

Status is PROPOSED. G09 selects a trusted base checker/registry and contains candidate execution, but candidate modules and tests share the interpreter that produces unittest outcomes and JSON. Arbitrary candidate code can alter that process's reporting state. Source identities and host report-shape validation do not independently establish honest assertion execution.

Define and verify a stronger boundary for one bounded, real server public-owner regression path. Preserve the current gates and their independently reviewed-code evidence while this proposal is reviewed. G10 repository enforcement remains a separate prerequisite for mechanical merge protection. This proposal accepts no new runtime or cutover semantics.

The coordinating role is the CI owner, with review by the selected real component owner and architecture reviewer. Actual human owner bindings remain subject to #743.

### Proposed Solution

- Keep the authoritative test plan, observations, assertion decisions and final verdict in a trusted process that imports no candidate Python.
- Run the candidate owner in a separately controlled process through a reviewed public boundary. The trusted side owns start, timeout, cancellation, exit, cleanup and result-channel handling. Candidate stdout, files and declared counts remain untrusted observations.
- Begin with one substantive existing public-owner path and its failure/recovery behavior. Reuse reviewed real-owner regression semantics and controlled external transports. Expand only after the first boundary has legal and adversarial proof.
- Bind expected source/runner/test-plan identities on the trusted side. Derive selected-case counts and pass/fail decisions there. Retain the present candidate-suite result as a separately scoped reviewed-code observation.
- Keep candidate execution free of deployment credentials and preserve source/dependency isolation, bounded nofollow artifact collection, old Node/Hypium/ArkTS/ST/pr-ready semantics and the existing architecture checker.
- Design the observer/worker protocol and failure model in a producer PR before enrolling its real consumer in CI. Proposed writable files and exact owner interfaces must be agreed in that implementation issue before work begins. No shared Store/schema, AGENTS, module-ownership policy, branch visibility or account-plan change is authorized here.

Additional hashes, report flags or a monkeypatch detector in candidate Python are insufficient to create this process boundary. The task must identify precisely which observations become trusted and which product behavior remains subject to review.

### Involved Public APIs

A proposed versioned observer/worker request and response protocol, one selected real server public proxy, and a trusted lifecycle/verdict interface. Exact names and schema are pending design review. Candidate report fields remain compatibility inputs and cannot self-authorize a trusted verdict.

### Test Verification

All acceptance below is planned and UNRUN for this stronger design.

- Legal control exercises the real selected owner, temporary persistence and named controlled transports. Record exact commits, interpreter/dependency/import origins, real participants, selected cases and original failures.
- Demonstrate the current same-process result-tampering counterexample safely in an isolated source copy. Preserve its legal and failing controls and source/runner/registry/report hashes. The current F2 audit supplies this witness after independent verification.
- Under the new boundary, candidate unittest/report monkeypatching, fabricated PASS/counts, early exit0, stale or missing responses, wrong identities and unsolicited output must fail to satisfy the trusted plan. A meaningful business-invariant violation must fail while the legal owner remains green.
- A candidate failure, timeout, cancellation, crash or late response must produce a truthful failed/unknown verdict and clean up only its owned processes/resources. No skipped/missing/zero-case required observation becomes a pass.
- Prove that candidate code cannot import or mutate the observer's assertion/verdict state, and that no credentialed host executes candidate build/test hooks.
- Independent review reruns the controls. After producer merge, a separate real consumer PR demonstrates the ordinary trusted-base CI path. Configure and verify repository enforcement through #746 when the required capability exists.

The runtime target and unchanged-client/default-cutover obligations retain their owning issues. A passing bounded observer task does not complete the overall migration.

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents
865.title: [RFC]: Add a trusted observer for adversarial server test results

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

When a Files request is denied at submission after agent read access has been revoked, DigitalMate displays a generic retry message. The Bridge returns FORBIDDEN before creating a task.

1. In the isolated Files provider, grant agent read access and read a file from the App.
2. Revoke access and ask the App to read the same file again.

884.author: huben0423-hw
884.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已检索相关 issue，未发现报告同类前缀缓存异常的条目。
- [x] 已附复现步骤与所报数据的截图。

### 🐞 问题详细描述

服务端前缀缓存疑似在一个前缀几乎未变化的请求上被完全失效，导致该请求被从头重新计算，而没有复用已缓存的前缀。

**复现步骤**
1. 在对话 `chat-6` 中依次发起请求，直到第 5 次请求（输入 59,019 tokens）。
2. 逐次查看每次请求的缓存统计（见下表）。
3. 将第 5 次与第 4 次对比：第 5 次仅多出 318 个输入 tokens，且与第 4 次相隔 17 秒。

| # | 输入 tokens | 命中缓存 | 未命中 | 单次命中率 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 22,610 | 17,920 | 4,690 | 79.26% |
| 2 | 28,913 | 22,400 | 6,513 | 77.47% |
| 3 | 52,261 | 28,672 | 23,589 | 54.86% |
| 4 | 58,701 | 52,096 | 6,605 | 88.75% |
| 5 | 59,019 | 128 | 58,891 | 0.22% |
| 合计 | 221,504 | 121,216 | 100,288 | 54.72% |

**实际现象。** 第 5 次请求仅报告 128 个缓存命中 tokens：单次命中率 0.22%，未命中 58,891 tokens —— 约占整个会话未命中总量（100,288）的 59%。内部标记显示前缀并未变化（`stable_prefix_changed` 为 false；`system_prompt` 与 `tools` 均未变），但该请求仍被从头计算。这一次调用把 `chat-6` 的整体命中率从约 75%（其余各次）拉低到 54.7%（合计 54.72%）。

**期望行为。** 在前缀几乎未变、距第 4 次请求仅 17 秒的情况下，应当复用已预热的前缀缓存。复用第 4 次约 88% 的命中率，可让 `chat-6` 整体回到约 78–79%，与全局约 80% 的命中率相符，而不是从零重新计算。

### 环境信息详细说明

DigitalMate 移动端 App（v0.1.9）；截图时间为北京时间 2026-11-08 00:55，对话 `chat-6` 共 5 次模型调用。设备型号：huawei nova 16；操作系统：HarmonyOS。

### 补充信息

数据来自所附截图中的缓存/用量统计。说明：
- 第 3 次请求新增约 2.3 万 tokens（消息量从约 12k 增至约 37k）；此处首次未命中属正常冷启动（非异常）。
- 第 5 次与第 3 次请求合计约占 `chat-6` 未命中总量的 82%。
- `chat-6` 仅 5 次调用，单次异常会被整体比例放大；不应仅据此判断为长期低命中率。

建议排查：
- 对比第 4 次与第 5 次请求的前缀差异。
- 检查缓存过期 / 淘汰行为。
- 检查其他对话是否出现相同的整段未命中。

### 版本信息

v0.1.9

### 截图 / 录屏

![chat-6 前缀缓存第 5 次请求仅命中 128 token（单次命中率 0.22%），并含 5 次调用明细](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/9f80a50bc8a7c481717f472ed8b26ebb31157799/.github/issue-assets/884/prefix-cache-128-token.jpg)
884.title: [Bug]: 偶现前缀缓存异常失效：前缀几乎未变却仅命中 128 token（单次命中率 0.22%）

888.body:
### Context
发现页 → 对比不同长度内容的信息卡片。来源：11月走查-记录.xlsx，工作表「11月走查」第3行；提出人：李韧；责任方：产品；问题类型：视觉。原文：每张信息卡的操作与底部边距不同。

### Test Environment
代码基线：main 8b412d6a7176676960d002b392296eb32393ed6a。使用生产 WATERFALL_CSS 和 renderCandidate 生成的卡片 HTML，在 Windows Edge/Chromium 无头浏览器中复现，视口宽度 320/412/480 CSS px。内容使用现有 renderer interaction 测试候选数据，网络请求被阻断。原始走查截图的 APP 构建号、手机型号及系统版本未提供。本次未进行鸿蒙手机验证。

### Problem Description & Suggestions
实际表现：文字信息卡操作栏下方出现随内容长短变化的大块留白。回归用例在未修改的 main 上失败：320px 视口中 text-current 的操作栏到底部为 87px，而期望为 25px。

原因：通用的 .waterfall-card:not(.waterfall-card--video-fullscreen) .waterfall-cinema-copy 设置 flex: 0 0 auto，其选择器优先级覆盖了文字卡片 flex-grow: 1；卡片仍保留最小高度，内容区未填满，操作栏的 margin-top: auto 无法吸收剩余空间。

建议：让普通文字卡片内容区恢复 flex: 1 1 auto，移除文字卡片最小高度并保持视口高度预算，操作栏固定保留 10px 上间距，避免将留白移动到按钮上方。验收：不同内容长度的文字卡片，操作栏到底部间距一致，操作按钮完整可见。

### Screenshots / Recordings
原始走查截图：
![UCD 第3行原始截图](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3c72a742b97a087ff4c15bcc15d13100c329f6b1/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/row3-discovery-spacing-original.png?raw=true)

浏览器复现（测试候选数据，不是手机截图）：
![main 修复前](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/8c6c8aa81207a367b6584b50c79b8edbd94daa91/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/row3-spacing-browser-before.png?raw=true)

浏览器修复验证（相同数据和样式入口）：
![修复后](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/aaa23e215f1fbb6ab2138cd3aafa5602f8183482/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/row3-spacing-browser-after.png?raw=true)

### Related PR
Fix: #889 (https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/889). Browser regression verified; HarmonyOS on-device acceptance remains pending.

### 手机反馈与后续修正
用户反馈 10029 仍在摘要和按钮间留下大块空白。PR #890 已更新为随内容收紧的文字卡片布局；加强后的回归测试能检出上一版问题，并在最终代码上通过。手机视觉验收待确认。

896.body:
## 现象与证据
- 请求时间：2026-11-08 00:28:51，整条请求耗时 300.9s。
- 工具执行共 150.6s，其中 4 次 bash 调用就占了 129.6s（占工具总时间 86%）。
- 明细：R17 = 66.2s、R14 = 28.9s、R15 = 23.4s、R24 = 11.1s。
- 数据来源：step_breakdown_tool_calls.csv；events.jsonl 中 tool-call 到 tool-result 的时间差。

## 影响
- 单条 bash 命令耗时可达 66s，且期间无超时控制、无进度反馈，用户长时间看不到任何反馈，感知为“卡死”，严重拖垮整条请求体验。

## 期望
- 为 bash / 长命令增加可配置超时与心跳进度。
- 超过 5s 输出阶段性进度并允许中断。
- 超长命令支持拆分执行。

## 标签
performance / tooling / P1

897.body:
## 现象与证据
- 5 个最慢请求合计 1188.4s，其中 LLM 耗时 835.1s，占 70.3%。
- 282.2s 那条请求共 28 轮，输入峰值 8.2 万 token。
- 264.8s 那条请求输入峰值 10.3 万 token。
- 单轮推理常见 10–24s。
- 数据来源：step_breakdown_per_round.csv。

## 影响
- LLM 耗时随上下文膨胀，轮次越多越慢，长任务尾延迟明显，占总时长约 70%。

## 期望
- 上下文裁剪 / 摘要，减少无关历史注入，提高缓存命中。
- 提供每轮 token 与耗时的监控视图。

## 标签
performance / llm / context / P1

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

助手回复正文末尾把内部控制行 `Next:` 及其后的 JSON 数组（包含 `label`、`ask`、`agent_id`、`view`、`ref` 等字段）原样当作普通文本显示，而不是解析为可点击的“下一步建议”按钮或隐藏。每条带建议动作的回复都会在末尾冒出这一段，表现为界面像“坏掉了一样”。本次在 2026-11-08 的本会话中多次复现。

复现步骤：

1. 在 DigitalMate 聊天中发送任意会触发“下一步建议”的消息（例如任务类请求完成后的回复）。
2. 查看助手回复的末尾。
3. 可观察到形如 `Next: [{"label": "...", "ask": "...", "agent_id": "", "view": false, "ref": ""}]` 的原文直接显示在正文里。

预期与实际：

- 预期：`Next:` 控制行及其 JSON 应由前端解析并渲染为可点击的后续建议按钮（或至少隐藏），普通聊天正文只保留自然语言/卡片内容。
- 实际：控制行与 JSON 作为纯文本出现在助手气泡末尾。

其它说明：这与 #306 是同一类问题（#306 于 2026-10-29 已标记 COMPLETED 关闭），但在 **v0.1.8（2026-11-06 发布）** 上仍然复现——该版本晚于 #306 的修复关闭时间，疑似回归或修复未覆盖全部渲染路径。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 渠道：Web 聊天端（channel=web）
- 时区 / 时间：Asia/Shanghai，2026-11-08（当天多次复现）
- 设备：华为 Mate X6（HUAWEI Mate X6）
- 系统 / 浏览器：未采集（如需要可补充）

### Additional Information

- 关联 issue：#306（已关闭 / 已完成）——同为“聊天正文直接展示 Next JSON”问题，本次为回归复现。
- 建议校验点：流式输出、最终结果、历史恢复三个渲染阶段都应隐藏控制行，避免只在单一阶段处理。
- 说明：本报告依据用户口述现象整理，暂无新增截图附件，视觉参考见 #306 的截图。

### Version Information

- 复现版本：DigitalMate **v0.1.8**（2026-11-06 发布）
- 仓库：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate
- 分支 / 基线：main @ e1fdf01456b1a8d32fc112779a465b37c584ed4e（2026-11-08）
- 最新发布：v0.1.9（2026-11-07）
- AppScope：versionCode 10006，versionName 0.1.0，buildVersion 1

无截图 / 录屏附件（当前仅文字复现）；此前的视觉证据见 #306：https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/306
